objects.name: Analytic 2253
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies an Industrial Control System (ICS) device or server accepting an inbound connection on its native protocol port from a source Internet Protocol (IP) address outside the organization's address space. Documented in Trend Micro's manufacturing honeypot research, with adversaries exploiting exposed Siemens S7, Omron Factory Interface Network Service (FINS), EtherNet/IP, and misconfigured Virtual Network Computing (VNC). OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the asset's documented role does not permit the connection and the destination/proxy/service is outside the approved communications profile, with process/service identity used as corroboration where available. Suppress approved vendor support, update repositories, remote operations, failover paths, and documented temporary connectivity.
